releaseSequenceConstraints: Treat HD-001 through HD-005 as confirmed patterns; obtain only their listed exact fail-closed parameters.
Establish Citadel management groups, separated platform/workload subscriptions and ALZ/AI/sovereignty policy composition before workload resources.
Pin and review the Azure-Samples Foundry Citadel source revision; preserve its status as an adapted architecture rather than a product dependency.
Establish both approved regional hubs, central DNS, identity and location policy before data or AI services.
Register and evidence Microsoft.Network/EnableApplicationGatewayNetworkIsolation in each target subscription before private-only Application Gateway resources; never substitute a public frontend.
Delegate every private Application Gateway subnet to Microsoft.Network/applicationGateways before ingress admission.

Set and evidence Azure SQL requestedBackupStorageRedundancy before data admission; production allows only Local or Zone after regional capability evidence and never silently accepts Geo/GeoZone. It applies to STR/LTR, changes future backups, can take up to 48 hours and removes geo-restore; approved failover groups provide cross-region recovery.
Approve the API Management private endpoint and prove central private DNS before setting publicNetworkAccess=Disabled; never restore the public gateway for recovery or troubleshooting.
Establish audit, immutable evidence and Internal Audit boundary before acceptance evidence is produced.
Enable source connectors only after source, permission, licence, privacy, retention and location evidence passes.
Enable AI analysis only after model/version/provider terms and AI governance evidence passes.
Use synthetic data through development and test.
Run the first three eligible production deals in parallel with reconciliation and explicit go/no-go records.
Stop admission after twenty completed eligible deals pending human acceptance.

phase5ValidationMatrix.command: az bicep format --stdout plus comparison; az bicep restore; az bicep lint; az bicep build; az bicep build-params

Official MCR manifest response records module, exact tag, Docker-Content-Digest, endpoint and retrieval time independently of Bicep restore.
Same schema for dev/tst/prd; fail-closed parameters have no invented production defaults.
Public access, location, tag, diagnostic, identity, SQL backup and APIM sequencing controls pass; secret scan is clean.
ARM schemas, names, dependencies, roles and assertions pass.

phase5ValidationMatrix.expected: Applicable format/lint/type/build/unit/integration, OpenAPI compatibility, migration, image/SBOM/signature/vulnerability/licence checks pass.

phase5ValidationMatrix.command: Invoke-LocalValidation.ps1 -Scope Release; resolve the iac root; enumerate normalised iac-relative paths; exclude out and release/content-hashes.json; ordinal-sort relative paths; hash each resolved full path with Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256; serialize only relative paths as compact UTF-8 JSON without BOM or trailing newline
phase5ValidationMatrix.expected: Schema-valid manifest and canonical, path-independent, recomputable complete content hashes without self-reference.
